comment: The seven revert-checks of `tooling-portability` (tasks 5.1–5.7) as a runnable set: one mutation each, the named case must go red, the file is restored, the case must go green again. Run it with `bash tools/mutate.sh --mutations tools/portability-mutations.json`; `.pi/skills/mutation-runner` owns how, `.pi/skills/revert-check` owns the rule. The evidence recorded in the change's `evidence/revert-checks.md` came from exactly these mutations.

mutations.replace: add "$value" "tools/tooling.json namespaces.category" word; done < <(printf '%s\n' build-and-harness ui verification)
mutations.why: the value set is read from the profile, not hard-coded
the source adapter is excluded from the engine set
the profile is resolved from the working tree, not from $HOME

mutations.label: 5.3b
mutations.why: …and a linked worktree resolves its own profile, not one read from $HOME (the same mutation, the task's second case)
GITHUB_REPOSITORY does not override the working tree
the synthetic project's repository differs from this one
the prompt substitutes the project's gate command instead of owning one
every command in the porting recipe runs
